name: Tailoring and Alteration Operations
audience: independent tailoring, alteration, and garment-repair shops
topic: fitting decisions and finished-garment pickup readiness

products.name: Fitting Decision Register
products.product: A focused tailoring fitting change approval tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent tailoring, alteration, and garment-repair shops
products.problem: Pin changes, customer fit comments, garment posture, measurements, promised date, added work, and price decisions from successive fittings can overwrite or contradict one another.
products.valueProposition: Turns tailoring fitting change approval tracking into a visible operating queue so every fitting produces an agreed current alteration plan, price or date consequence, garment marking reference, and next checkpoint.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets tailor fitting software, alteration fitting notes, garment measurement tracker, and tailoring change approval searches.

products.name: Garment Pickup Readiness
products.product: A focused alteration garment pickup readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent tailoring, alteration, and garment-repair shops
products.problem: A customer receives a ready message before final pressing, quality check, accessories, original material, balance, garment bag, or pickup authorization is reconciled.
products.valueProposition: Turns alteration garment pickup readiness into a visible operating queue so every finished garment is checked against approved work, packaged with customer property, financially reconciled, and staged before notification.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets alteration pickup tracker, tailor order ready, garment quality checklist, and tailoring order status searches.
